newsitem.title: USA: Sirena to take Q4 charge.
newsitem.headline: Sirena to take Q4 charge.

text.p: Sirena Apparel Group Inc plans to take special and non-recurring charges in the fourth quarter of $1.3 million.
The charges relate to termination of consulting agreement with a former director, a writedown of raw material inventories and start-up costs for the new Liz Claiborne swimwear line, Sirena said.

Prior to the one-time charge, fourth quarter and fiscal 1997 results are expected to fall within the lower range of analysts' consensus earnings estimates of breakeven to a loss of $0.09 per share on a fully taxed proforma basis, it said.
Sirena said sales and margins had been adversely impacted by generally sluggish retail activity since late April.
It said the slowdown in retail sales has reduced the levels of and prices paid for re-orders in the fourth quarter.
It said its fiscal 1997 performance will reflect improvement in terms of margin, reduced operating loss, lower overhead and inventory and improved retail performance.

It said it will enter fiscal 1998 with the launch of the Liz Claiborne swimwear collection, with overhead and inventory levels much improved, and strategically positioned to improve overall operating performance.
